messages:
emma (docs): Hey team — opening a small PR to consolidate the Private/VPC install notes + a new KMS/HSM SDK example. Need quick review for accuracy and any missing network callouts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1892 :wave:
ryan (eng): Thanks! I'll skim the network flow section. Can you highlight obvious changes so I can focus?
emma (docs): TL;DR: 1) clarified NAT vs. SNAT for private egress 2) added PKCS#11 example for Go SDK 3) added note about firewall stateful inspection and MTLS port list 4) fixed two dead links to our installer bundle checksum doc
leila (security): Quick ask: the PKCS#11 snippet — does it show how to limit key use to signing only? Need an example for HSM policy with minimal privileges.
mike (infra): Also need an explicit sentence about asymmetric key import timing — customers often hit HSM import race during upgrades. Suggest adding a preflight check in the upgrade section.
emma (docs): Good catches. I'll add an HSM policy example. For upgrade preflight I can add a short command: ```bash
# check HSM session available
openssl engine -t -c pkcs11 | grep -q PKCS11 && echo "HSM available" || echo "HSM not detected"
```
ryan (eng): FYI the NAT vs SNAT paragraph needs one concrete example: when redis caching on private subnet calls external model registry (s3). Right now it's vague.
leila (security): For the PKCS#11 snippet, propose we include this minimal policy JSON so customers can see `allow_sign: true` and `allow_decrypt: false`. e.g.: ```json
{
  "roles": [
    {"name": "model-server-hsm", "capabilities": ["sign"], "objects": ["key-model-prod"] }
  ]
}
```
emma (docs): I'll add that exact JSON and mention not to enable key export/import unless needed. Also adding link to HSM vendor docs (we'll vendor-agnostic link out to PKCS#11 spec).
ci-bot: build docs/pr-1892 — checks passed ✅
ryan (eng): Left two small inline comments on the PR re: wording and the NAT example. 
emma (docs): Addressed both, pushed a follow-up commit. Also fixed the two broken links — updated checksum doc link to https://docs.redwood.ai/installer/checksums.
mike (infra): One more: in networking checklist, add a note about UDP-based discovery being blocked by some NATs (we saw this in onprem tests).
emma (docs): Good call. I'll add: "If using UDP-based service discovery ensure NAT traversal or use TCP fallback". Anything else?
leila (security): Nits: add a short sentence on KMS audit logging retention and pointer to compliance playbook. Then LGTM from security.
emma (docs): Added audit logging note + link to compliance playbook. Requesting final reviewers: @ryan, @mike. If no objections I'll merge tomorrow morning after CI. :thumbsup:
ryan (eng): Ok by me, merge after 09:00 UTC.
mike (infra): SGTM.
emma (docs): Thanks all — merging in the morning and will announce in #private-deploys release notes.
